steps.title: Verify FFPE Block Identity
steps.instruction: Verify the identity of the FFPE block to be cut against the written request for sectioning.

steps.title: Label Slides
steps.instruction: Label all slides with a unique BEMS ID and slide number according to the written request and FFPE spatial map.

substeps.instruction: Slide 2: Superfrost Plus, Cyclic Immunofluorescence Tumor Panel (HMS, Alyce Chen)
Slide 3: Superfrost Plus, Cyclic Immunofluorescence Immune Panel (HMS, Alyce Chen)
Slide 4: TOMO Multiplex IHC Discovery Panel (OHSU, Sam Sivagnanam)
Slide 5: Tanner Cyclic Immunofluorescence Panel A (OHSU, Koei Chin)
Slide 6: Tanner Cyclic Immunofluorescence Panel B (OHSU, Koei Chin)
Slide 7: Superfrost Plus, Nanostring GeoMx Digital Spatial Profiler (OHSU, KDL)

steps.title: Prepare and Cut Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Align the block on the microtome to minimize tissue loss and section the block.

substeps.instruction: Face into block at 5μm until a full section of tissue is achieved.
Cut an adequate ribbon at 5μm to cover all 8 serial sections.

steps.title: Mount Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Mount tissue sections onto the appropriate slide types, maintaining the serial order and orientation of sections.

steps.title: Perform H&E Staining
steps.instruction: Perform hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining on slides #1 and #8.

steps.title: Bake Slides
steps.instruction: Bake slides #2, 3, 5, and 6 in an oven using a two-step temperature process.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in a 55 °C oven overnight.
The next morning, raise the oven temperature to 65 °C for up to 01:00:00 (minimum 30 minutes).

steps.title: Store and Deliver Slides
steps.instruction: Remove slides from the oven and prepare for distribution.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in slide boxes and store at room temperature.
Deliver slides #2 through #7 to BioLibrary for distribution.
